the probability of collision increases with increasing number of BLE devices in the vicinity and that the aggregate throughput of a group of BLE devices decreases when the number of collocated devices increase.

the selection probability of the BLE data channel is inversely proportional to the number of active BLE devices in the proximity and that the aggregate data rate of a set of BLE devices is inversely proportional with the square of the number of devices.

(i) the selection probabilities of the 37 data channels of BLE are non-uniform; (ii) the selection probability of a channel is proportional to the number of times it appears in the frequency hopping sequence; (iii) the selection probability increases with the number of BLE pairs in a collocated environment; (iv) the selection probabilities can be exploited to maximize the aggregate throughput in a multi-pair scenario.
